newsitem.title: USA: Manugistics sets 1.9 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Manugistics sets 1.9 mln shr offering.

text.p: Manugistics Group Inc said Wednesday it has launched a secondary offering of up to 1.9 million common shares.
Of the total, it said it was offering 1.6 million shares while a shareholder was selling 300,000 shares.

It said it would use net proceeds from the offering for working capital and other general corporate purposes, including expansion into inernational markets, acceleration of product releases and possible acquisitions.

The offering's underwriters are Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, and Robertson, Stephens & Co LLC. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 285,000 additional shares, it said.
Manugistics develops, markets, and supports software products for so-called synchronized supply chain management, and related services.
